methodology: Operating-program evidence and physical-location evidence are evaluated separately.
Dated relocation/ownership notices supersede older general marketing pages; contradictions remain in notes.
Geocoders locate published addresses, not aircraft operations. Airport/campus references are explicitly approximate.
No base numbers are inferred from database marker IDs. No hospital is assumed to be a base simply because it accepts helicopter flights.
A 75 NM circle is a uniform geographic comparison, not an aircraft range, availability, clinical capability or dispatch guarantee.
No new base phone data is included.
